name: Sangani Hospitals Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2021, Sangani Hospitals is in the business of Hospital, Laboratory, and Pharmacy[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
SHL is in the business of Hospitals, pathological laboratory and Pharmacy stores. It operates 2 hospitals viz. Sangani Hospital at Keshod, Gujarat, and Sangani Super Speciality Hospital, Veraval, Gujarat. It also operates 2 pathology laboratories and 2 medical  stores.

cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has a low return on equity of 9.54% over last 3 years.
Earnings include an other income of Rs.1.07 Cr.
